After half a year of intermittent updates, I finally completed a version that barely satisfied me. At the moment of completion, there was a sense of accomplishment, and I was very happy. I think I've reached the limit of what I'm capable of, and I think it's a work that will allow me to at least not suffer from the disconnect of the art style.

Thank you to the friends who tracked down this mod, you are also witnesses to the completion of this mod

Without further ado, I hope you enjoy it
